On August 11, 2021, we were eating at home and this bird, House Sparrow, flew into the house and landed on the TV cabinet. 
Always around 3pm we throw the leftover bread crumbs from the meal on the balcony and the same number of birds always come, this bird was not afraid of us and went inside the house. It did not get scared when we passed by and left when it wanted to.

This sparrow chick fell out of the nest, but we managed to find said nest and put it back! :)

Before being able to do so, i made it a nest out of towels and included a hand warming pad (wrapped in paper) so that the bird could sit on, or move away from it, for temp regulation. I checked the bird for any fractures or wounds, and if there were any visible parasites, but it seemed alright and nothing looked "off" or broken.
Then we caught some flies, dunked them in water and gave it to the baby, who was apparently very hungry! It was very vocal and stretched out to my hands to get fed. I learned (from my expert family member) that giving them liquids would result into getting it into their lungs.
After some roof climbing in the dark, the sparrow could be returned to his family.

Happy ending :)
